## Public Benchmark Claims

Public headline copy is generated from the versioned [headline-claim registry](../../benchmarks/public-headline-claims.edn). Every published claim is bound to an evaluator implementation hash, policy hash, and immutable evidence-package reference.

No public headline claims are currently published. Registry entries remain draft until a qualifying evidence package is committed or otherwise published with a SHA-256 reference.

### Publication rule

A claim is rendered only at `:published` status. Validation rejects a published entry whose evaluator source hash or policy hash has drifted, or that lacks a package URI and SHA-256.
